description: Read-side catalog record describing a municipality (市区町村 / city / borough / commune / county). Originally `vertex_gov_municipality` table. Per ADR-2605212100 the etzhayyim-side Kysely table is replaced by MST records under this collection. Cross-references `com.etzhayyim.gov.agency` (municipalities are agencies too — `branch=executive level=municipal`); this collection exists for the common case of name/code lookup without the full agency surface.

code.description: Authoritative municipality code. Format depends on jurisdiction: JIS X 0402 6-digit for JP (e.g. '131016' for 千代田区), FIPS-2 / FIPS-5 for US, NUTS 3 / LAU for EU, GBR ONS code for UK.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 lowercase, optionally with subnational suffix. Example: 'jpn', 'usa-ca', 'gbr-eng'.

prefecture.description: Parent prefecture / state / region. Format: name or subnational code. Example: '東京都', 'California', 'Bavaria'.

prefectureCode.description: Authoritative prefecture / state code (e.g. JIS X 0401 2-digit for JP: '13' for 東京都; US state postal: 'CA').

population.description: Posted population (as of record creation). Source-snapshot only; not authoritative.
